name: MiniMo: Crazy Chase
detailed_description:
The chase is on!

MiniMo: Crazy Chase is an online, fast-paced, asymmetrical twist on the classic hide 'n seek formula for 1-5 players where players fulfill one of two different roles.

Either they are MONSTERS, hiding to avoid getting caught and seeking to collect all the keys before it's too late... or they play as THE ROBOT, hiding from NO ONE but seeking to chase and collect all of those puny, soon-to-be incarcerated monsters! 

It's a party game through and through, inviting you to jumpscare your friends or steel your stealthy nerves in quick matches that last no longer than 2 minutes!

Over in a FLASH(light)!

The good news is you can see things in front of you. The bad news is, that's the ONLY thing you can see! All stages are shrouded in darkness, your flashlights the only weapon against this dim unknown.

If a monster flashes their lights on a key for some time, they collect it. But if a monster stays within the horrifyingly red light of the robot, it gets CAUGHT and put in monster-jail! 

When your flashlights are on, you are easily detected. So just turn them off, right? Well, wise guy, when you turn them off, you won't be able to see anything – neither keys, nor ally nor enemy! Tough choice!

If all keys are collected, the monsters win. If all monsters have been caught, the robot wins!

But wait, isn't 4 vs 1 unfair?

Well, unfair for whom?

When you play as the ROBOT...
you, and you alone, get to be the sci-fi-horror-villain I always knew you could be, making the monsters sweat as they desperately try to avoid you. But you do have a few tricks up your, um, sleeve. Wait, do robots have sleeves?

For one, the monsters are on the clock... you are NOT! If time runs out, you ALSO win! 
Secondly, as the game progresses, and those monsters (hopefully and/or regrettably) collect more and more keys, your robot software unlocks hidden benefits.

The monsters, though... 
are slippery and, well, plural! Oh, and they have a few monster-powers they'll try to use at the right time to (hopefully and/or regrettably) gain the upper hand. Wait, do monsters have upper hands?

Also,

it's not over till it's over. Fellow monsters may try to orchestrate a PRISON BREAK for their allies – teamwork is the key to victory!  That, and the actual keys, I guess.

So what are you waiting for?

Seriously! The robot is chasing you, and crazily too. RUN!!

KEY FEATURES

  • 5+ unique stages!

  • Lobbies that allow for playing online with strangers or friends!

  • AI monsters and robots!

  • Monster customization!

  • Powerful monster abilities!

  • Multiple ways to win!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd–3rd gen) or AMD A6/A8
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
